item.title: A world war? Iran war draws in more than regional rivals
item.summary: One war can fuel another. After the United States and Israel launched an operation that began on Day One with the assassination of Iran’s Supreme Leader, Donald Trump expressed surprise at Tehran’s decision to draw in Gulf oil producers and disrupt global supplies.

item.title: Citi, StanChart evacuate Dubai offices, HSBC closes Qatar branches as fears grow
item.summary: US financial service group Citi and two other companies in Dubai's financial centre asked employees to evacuate their offices on Wednesday after Iran threatened to strike US and Israel-linked banks in the Middle East. FRANCE 24's Camille Knight has more.

item.title: US likely responsible for deadly Iran school strike after targeting error, report says
item.summary: The New York Times on Wednesday reported that a US Tomahawk missile likely hit a school in Iran due to outdated targeting data, killing more than 150 people. This comes after US President Donald Trump suggested that Iran itself might have been responsible for the strike.
